reviews.text: It's been a few years since Barry's did a big restoration project on a great, old car of mine. They did such a good job. Their paint matching and quality is so good. They can also add on, small, detailed, trim repair and painting. Wonderful job.
reviews.author: Max K.

reviews.text: They worked hard to solve the problems that came up and communicated well

reviews.text: Great, quick experience with Barry’s! They were super helpful and great with communication.
